lines.zh: 蠕动前行，触手不断伸展收缩
lines.en: Creeping, tentacles expanding and contracting

lines.zh: 缓缓移动，搜寻猎物踪迹
lines.en: Moving slowly, searching for prey

lines.zh: 触手迅速缠绕，抓住目标
lines.en: Tentacles quickly缠绕, grabbing the target

lines.zh: 在黑暗中无声滑行
lines.en: Sliding silently in the dark

lines.zh: 寻找腐烂的气息
lines.en: Seeking the stench of decay

lines.zh: 触手在夜色中缓缓蠕动
lines.en: Tentacles蠕动 in the night

lines.zh: 黑暗中悄然逼近
lines.en: Creeping silently in the dark

lines.zh: 液态虚空触手缓缓游动
lines.en: Liquid void tentacles slowly moving

lines.zh: 触手寻找猎物的脚步声
lines.en: Tentacles searching for prey

lines.zh: 在阴影中悄悄移动
lines.en: Moving quietly in the shadows

lines.zh: 污泥里滑过，留下一道湿痕
lines.en: It slides through the mire, leaving a wet trail.

lines.zh: 绕过石块，液态躯体不断变形
lines.en: Its liquid body reshapes itself around the stones.

lines.zh: 液态虚空凝固于地面
lines.en: Liquid void solidifying on the ground

lines.zh: 触手懒洋洋地垂落
lines.en: Tentacles hanging lazily

lines.zh: 缓缓流淌的虚空液体
lines.en: Sluggish liquid void flowing

lines.zh: 触手在原地轻轻摆动
lines.en: Tentacles swaying gently in place

lines.zh: 虚空液体在寂静中流动
lines.en: Liquid void flowing silently

lines.zh: 触手静止不动，如同雕塑
lines.en: Tentacles still, like a sculpture

lines.zh: 虚空触手缓慢波动
lines.en: Void tentacles gently oscillating

lines.zh: 触手停滞于半空
lines.en: Tentacles hanging in mid-air

lines.zh: 液态虚空在地面流淌
lines.en: Liquid void flowing on the ground

lines.zh: 触手在黑暗中静止
lines.en: Tentacles still in the dark

lines.zh: 缠绕在枯木上，缓缓滴落
lines.en: It coils around a dead log and drips slowly.

lines.zh: 在污秽沼泽里收缩成一团
lines.en: It shrinks into a knot in the foul swamp.

lines.zh: 光影扫过，它立刻缩回泥里
lines.en: When light sweeps past, it recoils into the mud.

lines.zh: 没有眼睛，却一直对着你的方向
lines.en: It has no eyes, yet it keeps facing your way.

lines.zh: 触手迅速朝玩家伸去
lines.en: Tentacles rapidly reaching for the player

lines.zh: 触手感知到玩家的气息
lines.en: Tentacles sensing the player

lines.zh: 触手警惕地注视玩家
lines.en: Tentacles cautiously watching the player

lines.zh: 触手围绕玩家慢慢移动
lines.en: Tentacles slowly moving around the player

lines.zh: 触手追踪玩家的移动
lines.en: Tentacles tracking the player's movement

lines.zh: 触手快速缠绕玩家
lines.en: Tentacles quickly wrapping around the player

lines.zh: 触手紧紧握住玩家
lines.en: Tentacles tightly grasping the player

lines.zh: 触手靠近玩家进行攻击
lines.en: Tentacles approaching to attack

lines.zh: 触手锁定玩家的呼吸
lines.en: Tentacles locking on to the player's breath

lines.zh: 触手缠绕在玩家周身
lines.en: Tentacles wrapping around the player

lines.zh: 触手尖端抬起，像在嗅探你
lines.en: The tentacle tip lifts as if sniffing you.

lines.zh: 一根触手悄悄搭上你的肩膀
lines.en: A tentacle quietly settles on your shoulder.

lines.zh: 你手里的火把让它迟疑了一下
lines.en: The torch in your hand makes it hesitate.

lines.zh: 它顺着脚印一路摸到你脚下
lines.en: It follows your footprints right to your feet.

lines.zh: 湿润的吸盘贴上你的护甲
lines.en: Wet suckers press against your armor.

lines.zh: 它在丈量你的距离，一寸一寸
lines.en: It measures the distance to you, inch by inch.

lines.zh: 被注视时，它反而贴得更近
lines.en: When watched, it presses even closer.

lines.zh: 触手抬起，模仿你抬手的动作
lines.en: A tentacle rises, mimicking your raised hand.

lines.zh: 你的呼吸让触手微微一颤
lines.en: Your breath makes the tentacle quiver.

lines.zh: 它绕到你背后，堵住退路
lines.en: It slips behind you and blocks your retreat.

lines.zh: 触手失去光泽，痛苦呻吟！
lines.en: The tentacle loses its luster and groans in pain!

lines.zh: 触手摇曳着哀号！
lines.en: The tentacle wavers and wails in agony!

lines.zh: 液态虚空在痛苦中扭曲！
lines.en: The liquid void twists in agony!

lines.zh: 触手无力地扭动，痛苦不已！
lines.en: The tentacle writhes weakly in agony!

lines.zh: 触手痛苦地蠕动着！
lines.en: The tentacle squirms in pain!

lines.zh: 触手痛苦地蜷缩起来！
lines.en: The tentacle curls up in agony!

lines.zh: 触手痛苦地颤抖！
lines.en: The tentacle trembles in pain!

lines.zh: 触手痛苦地呻吟！
lines.en: The tentacle groans in pain!

lines.zh: 触手痛苦地扭动！
lines.en: The tentacle twists in pain!

lines.zh: 触手痛苦地扭曲！
lines.en: The tentacle contorts in pain!

lines.zh: 你靠近得太近了，虚空触手嘶嘶作响。
lines.en: You got too close, the void tentacle hisses.

lines.zh: 触手缓缓蠕动，寻找你的气息。
lines.en: The tentacle slowly moves, seeking your scent.

lines.zh: 你无法抵挡虚空触手的诱惑。
lines.en: You can't resist the void tentacle's allure.

lines.zh: 黑暗中，触手缓缓伸向你。
lines.en: In the dark, the tentacle slowly reaches for you.

lines.zh: 虚空触手在黑暗中悄悄靠近。
lines.en: The void tentacle sneaks closer in the darkness.

lines.zh: 你闻到了触手散发出的腐败气息。
lines.en: You smell the corruption emanating from the tentacle.

lines.zh: 触手在你耳边轻声呢喃。
lines.en: The tentacle whispers in your ear.

lines.zh: 你感觉自己被虚空触手包裹。
lines.en: You feel the void tentacle wrap around you.

lines.zh: 黑暗中，触手触碰你的皮肤。
lines.en: In the dark, the tentacle touches your skin.

lines.zh: 虚空触手缓缓渗透你的思维。
lines.en: The void tentacle seeps into your mind.

lines.zh: 你的剑被虚空触手撕裂。
lines.en: Your sword is torn apart by the void tentacle.

lines.zh: 虚空触手从黑暗中猛然冲出。
lines.en: The void tentacle bursts out of the darkness.

lines.zh: 你被虚空触手弹开。
lines.en: You are repelled by the void tentacle.

lines.zh: 触手紧紧缠绕你的身体。
lines.en: The tentacle wraps tightly around your body.

lines.zh: 你试图摆脱虚空触手的束缚。
lines.en: You struggle to free yourself from the void tentacle's grip.

lines.zh: 虚空触手在你与它之间来回摆动。
lines.en: The void tentacle swings back and forth between you.

lines.zh: 触手撕裂你的装备。
lines.en: The tentacle rips through your equipment.

lines.zh: 你被黑暗中的触手击中。
lines.en: You are hit by a tentacle in the darkness.

lines.zh: 触手从你的防护中穿过。
lines.en: The tentacle pierces through your defenses.

lines.zh: 虚空触手的撕咬令你痛彻心扉。
lines.en: The void tentacle's bite is agony.

lines.zh: 虚空触手间无声的交流。
lines.en: The void tentacles communicate silently.

lines.zh: 触手之间形成了一条通道。
lines.en: A passage forms between the tentacles.

lines.zh: 它们缓慢地相互缠绕。
lines.en: They slowly wrap around each other.

lines.zh: 虚空触手间发出微弱的光芒。
lines.en: A faint light emanates from the void tentacles.

lines.zh: 它们的触手在黑暗中轻轻碰撞。
lines.en: Their tentacles gently collide in the darkness.

lines.zh: 它们似乎在进行某种仪式。
lines.en: They seem to be performing some ritual.

lines.zh: 触手间传来轻微的震动。
lines.en: A slight vibration travels between the tentacles.

lines.zh: 它们之间似乎有着某种联系。
lines.en: There seems to be some connection between them.

lines.zh: 触手间形成了一种默契。
lines.en: A mutual understanding forms between the tentacles.

lines.zh: 它们缓慢地靠近彼此。
lines.en: They slowly move closer to each other.

lines.zh: 黏液在滴落，触手更显狰狞。
lines.en: Goo drips, making the tentacle more horrifying.

lines.zh: 黑暗中，触手无声地蠕动。
lines.en: In the dark, the tentacle moves silently.

lines.zh: 黑暗中的触手，吞噬一切生命。
lines.en: The tentacle in the darkness devours all life.

lines.zh: 你感到触手冰冷的触碰。
lines.en: You feel the cold touch of the tentacle.

lines.zh: 触手伸向你，黑暗中无声。
lines.en: The tentacle reaches for you, silently in the dark.

lines.zh: 黑暗中，触手悄悄接近。
lines.en: In the dark, the tentacle sneaks closer.

lines.zh: 虚空之触，无处不在。
lines.en: Void touch, everywhere.

lines.zh: 光线下，触手停止生长。
lines.en: In the light, the tentacle stops growing.

lines.zh: 触手在黑暗中迅速恢复。
lines.en: The tentacle rapidly heals in the dark.

lines.zh: 你听到触手轻微的蠕动声。
lines.en: You hear the tentacle's slight movements.

lines.zh: 触手紧紧缠绕你的脚踝。
lines.en: The tentacle tightly wraps around your ankle.

lines.zh: 你感到触手的冰冷缠绕。
lines.en: You feel the cold tentacle wrapping around you.

lines.zh: 触手迅速向你伸展。
lines.en: The tentacle rapidly extends toward you.

lines.zh: 黑暗中，触手悄然接近。
lines.en: In the dark, the tentacle silently approaches.

lines.zh: 触手迅速缠上你的手臂。
lines.en: The tentacle quickly wraps around your arm.

lines.zh: 你被触手紧紧抓住。
lines.en: You are tightly grabbed by the tentacle.

lines.zh: 触手缠绕你的腰部。
lines.en: The tentacle wraps around your waist.

lines.zh: 触手迅速向你触碰。
lines.en: The tentacle quickly touches you.

lines.zh: 触手紧紧抓住你的大腿。
lines.en: The tentacle tightly grabs your thigh.

lines.zh: 缠住你的脚踝，往泥里拖
lines.en: It coils around your ankle and drags you toward the mud.

lines.zh: 触手收紧，发出黏腻的声响
lines.en: The tentacles tighten with a wet, sticky sound.

lines.zh: 它认准了你，甩开其他猎物
lines.en: It picks you and lets the other prey go.

lines.zh: 尖端刺入地面，把你围住
lines.en: Its tips stab the ground and fence you in.

lines.zh: 从沼泽底伸出，抓住你的腿
lines.en: It reaches up from the swamp floor and grabs your leg.

lines.zh: 触手甩来，打掉你手中的火把
lines.en: A tentacle whips out and knocks the torch from your hand.

lines.zh: 它把你往黑暗深处拽
lines.en: It pulls you toward the dark depths.

lines.zh: 黑暗中，触手寻找你的踪迹。
lines.en: In the dark, the tentacle searches for your trail.

lines.zh: 触手感知到你的气息。
lines.en: The tentacle senses your presence.

lines.zh: 触手追踪着你的声音。
lines.en: The tentacle tracks your voice.

lines.zh: 触手向你移动。
lines.en: The tentacle moves toward you.

lines.zh: 触手寻找你的踪迹。
lines.en: The tentacle searches for your trail.

lines.zh: 触手追踪着你的足迹。
lines.en: The tentacle tracks your footprints.

lines.zh: 触手靠近你。
lines.en: The tentacle approaches you.

lines.zh: 触手向你发起攻击。
lines.en: The tentacle attacks you.

lines.zh: 触手寻找你的身影。
lines.en: The tentacle searches for your figure.

lines.zh: 触手追踪你的动作。
lines.en: The tentacle tracks your movements.

lines.zh: 触手在你四周立起，慢慢合拢
lines.en: Tentacles rise around you and slowly close in.

lines.zh: 黏液一滴滴落，它在等你犯错
lines.en: Slime drips as it waits for you to slip.

lines.zh: 每一根触手都对准了你
lines.en: Every tentacle is aimed at you.

lines.zh: 它避开火光，绕向你的侧面
lines.en: It avoids the torchlight and circles to your flank.

lines.zh: 在泥里潜行，只露出触手尖
lines.en: It creeps through the mud, showing only its tips.

lines.zh: 触手敲打地面，试探你的反应
lines.en: Its tentacles tap the ground, testing your reaction.

lines.zh: 你一后退，触手就追进一步
lines.en: Each step you retreat, a tentacle advances.

lines.zh: 它在等光弱下去再动手
lines.en: It waits for the light to fade before striking.

lines.zh: 触手缠住木桩，借力扑向你
lines.en: A tentacle wraps a stake and slings itself at you.

lines.zh: 它耐心地缩紧包围圈
lines.en: It patiently tightens the ring around you.

lines.zh: 它从黑暗中伸出触手！
lines.en: It extends its tentacle from the darkness!

lines.zh: 触手挤压你的身体！
lines.en: The tentacle squeezes your body!

lines.zh: 感受它的触感吧！
lines.en: Feel its texture!

lines.zh: 触手缠绕你的四肢！
lines.en: The tentacle wraps around your limbs!

lines.zh: 痛苦将伴随着你！
lines.en: Pain will accompany you!

lines.zh: 它是黑暗中的噩梦！
lines.en: It is a nightmare in the dark!

lines.zh: 触手撕裂你的皮肤！
lines.en: The tentacle tears your skin!

lines.zh: 黑暗给予它力量！
lines.en: Darkness gives it power!

lines.zh: 触手吞噬你的生命！
lines.en: The tentacle devours your life!

lines.zh: 黑暗里，我的伤自己合上。
lines.en: In the dark, my wounds close themselves.

lines.zh: 触手抽在你背上，火辣辣地疼
lines.en: A tentacle whips your back with a burning sting.

lines.zh: 吸盘撕开皮肉，血渗进泥里
lines.en: Suckers tear your skin, blood seeping into the mud.

lines.zh: 它把你往沼泽深处压
lines.en: It forces you down into the depths of the swamp.

lines.zh: 湿冷的触手勒住你的喉咙
lines.en: A cold, wet tentacle clamps around your throat.

lines.zh: 触手猛地一扯，你差点摔倒
lines.en: A tentacle yanks hard and nearly throws you down.

lines.zh: 液体般的力道灌进你的伤口
lines.en: Liquid force seeps into your wounds.

lines.zh: 虚空之光中浮现触手！
lines.en: A tentacle emerges from the void light!

lines.zh: 黑暗中裂开触手！
lines.en: A tentacle splits open in the darkness!

lines.zh: 它从污秽沼泽中爬出！
lines.en: It crawls out from the mire!

lines.zh: 虚空触手降临！
lines.en: Void tentacle descends!

lines.zh: 沼泽的水面鼓起来了！
lines.en: The swamp surface is bulging!

lines.zh: 它从虚空的裂缝中出现！
lines.en: It emerges from a rift in the void!

lines.zh: 黑暗中裂开新的触手！
lines.en: A new tentacle splits open in the darkness!

lines.zh: 触手从虚空深渊中爬出！
lines.en: The tentacle crawls out from the void abyss!

lines.zh: 黑暗中的触手苏醒！
lines.en: The tentacle awakens in the darkness!

lines.zh: 它从黑暗中蠕动而来！
lines.en: It crawls from the darkness!

lines.zh: 沼泽冒泡，触手顶开烂泥
lines.en: The swamp bubbles as a tentacle pushes through the muck.

lines.zh: 一摊黑液聚拢成触手
lines.en: A pool of black liquid gathers into a tentacle.

lines.zh: 腐水翻涌，它从底下探出
lines.en: The foul water churns and it rises from below.

lines.zh: 泥浆裂开，伸出湿滑的一截
lines.en: The mud splits and a slick length slides out.

lines.zh: 芦苇丛摇晃，它就在里面
lines.en: The reeds sway; it is in there.

lines.zh: 黑暗里多了一团蠕动的东西
lines.en: Something writhing has joined the dark.

lines.zh: 沼泽的水面忽然下沉
lines.en: The swamp's surface suddenly sinks.

lines.zh: 触手一根接一根立起来
lines.en: One tentacle after another stands upright.

lines.zh: 它从烂泥里慢慢抽身
lines.en: It slowly draws itself out of the rotten mud.

lines.zh: 夜色落下，沼泽开始蠕动
lines.en: Night falls and the swamp begins to writhe.

lines.zh: 触手在烈焰中嘶嘶作响，痛苦加剧！
lines.en: The tentacle hisses in agony from the flames!

lines.zh: 触手从高处跌落，痛苦哀号！
lines.en: The tentacle cries in agony as it falls from a height!

lines.zh: 触手在水中痛苦挣扎！
lines.en: The tentacle struggles in pain in the water!

lines.zh: 触手被爆炸震伤，痛苦不已！
lines.en: The tentacle is shaken by the explosion and in pain!

lines.zh: 触手被箭矢射中，痛苦哀号！
lines.en: The tentacle cries in pain from an arrow!

lines.zh: 触手被魔法击中，痛苦扭曲！
lines.en: The tentacle twists in pain from magic!

lines.zh: 触手因饥饿而虚弱，痛苦哀号！
lines.en: The tentacle cries in pain from starvation!

lines.zh: 触手被闪电击中，痛苦扭曲！
lines.en: The tentacle twists in pain from lightning!

lines.zh: 触手接触光明，痛苦加剧！
lines.en: The tentacle's pain intensifies in the light!
